major_concerns: Simulator fidelity may not capture vendor-specific CLI subtleties (threat to internal/external validity).
Translation-first pipeline depends critically on completeness/ correctness of vendor DSLs—missing constructs bias comparison.
Verifier-model translation errors could produce false negatives attributed to generation.
Potential asymmetry in engineering effort between pipelines (hand-crafted DSLs vs agentic heuristics) may confound results.
Retry and API-failure handling needs clearer operationalization to avoid silent reruns.
required_design_repairs: Provide concrete vendor-CLI grammar/specs and validation tests; publish grammars used.
Include an isolated verification of translation correctness (unit tests: ground-truth config→formal-model roundtrip).
Define and validate simulator fidelity with a small held-out set of real vendor examples or community datasets.
Specify exact LLM model identifiers, decoding settings, seeds, and full retry policy for API failures.
Predefine metrics and thresholds for rollback triggers and treatment of translator/verifier-originated failures.

major_concerns: Effectiveness of schema-constrained decoding hinges on accuracy/completeness of vendor grammars.
RAG results are sensitive to retrieval corpus coverage; missing vendor docs will bias comparisons.
Evaluating explanatory (CoT) quality requires human annotation—annotation protocol and agreement not specified.
Regeneration policy (when schema rejects) can alter effective budget and must be bounded.
required_design_repairs: Produce and release vendor grammars/DSLs and tests demonstrating coverage.
Curate and document the retrieval corpus used for RAG; include retrieval evaluation (recall@k on vendor docs).
Define annotation protocol for CoT explanatory utility, annotator selection, and inter-annotator agreement thresholds.
Preregister exact regeneration strategy (max attempts, backoff) and power analysis linking sample size to detectable effect on semantic-violation rates.

major_concerns: Injected-fault distributions may not reflect real-world fault prevalence (external validity risk).
Operational-availability simulation omits human-operator latencies and scheduling constraints unless modeled explicitly.
Choice of cost weights for trade-off analyses is subjective and can change conclusions.
Validator implementations and tunable thresholds need careful specification; different validators are not equivalent.
required_design_repairs: Justify and document injected-fault generation process; include multiple plausible distributions and sensitivity runs.
Model human operator latency and maintenance windows or justify omission; include sensitivity analysis.
Predefine a set of cost-weight scenarios (stakeholder-driven) and report results across them rather than a single weighting.
Specify validator implementations, training/threshold procedures, and provide their confusion-matrix baseline on held-out tasks.

major_concerns: Full factorial design may exceed the practical model-call budget or reduce per-cell power.
RAG effectiveness again depends on retrieval corpus quality; unspecified index threatens interpretability.
Findings may be model-family specific if only one hosted LLM is used; generality limited.
CoT may produce verbose outputs complicating structured extraction; extraction method not specified.
required_design_repairs: Perform a preregistered power analysis and, if necessary, reduce factor levels or sampling per cell to guarantee interpretable CIs.
Specify and publish retrieval index and retrieval quality metrics; include sensitivity runs with degraded retrieval.
Prespecify parsing/extraction pipeline for structured CLI fields and validate it on held-out examples.
If only one LLM is available, explicitly state limits to generality and, where possible, include at least one alternative decoding/size setting as robustness check.
